ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe spawning Python/PowerShell child (BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret loader chain)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Famous Chollima developer-targeting chain where a victim runs `npm install` (or `node app.js`) from a trojanized coding-challenge repo and the Node runtime spawns curl/PowerShell/Python to fetch and execute the InvisibleFerret Python backdoor. Famous Chollima (a.k.a. UNC5342 / DEV#POPPER cluster) has used this exact JavaScript-stager-to-Python-implant pivot across every Contagious Interview wave since 2023.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe") by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process | rename Processes.* as * | where match(cmdline,"(?i)(http://|https://|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|IEX|-EncodedCommand|import\s+(urllib|requests|socket|base64|platform)|pip\s+install|exec\(|eval\()") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Famous Chollima Contagious Interview — node.exe spawning script-interpreter child with download/exec markers
let Lookback = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","import urllib","import requests","import socket","import base64","import platform","pip install","exec(","eval(","/pdown","/uploads","/keys","/client/")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("postinstall","preinstall","install.js","app.js","helper.js","loader.js","payload.js","main.js","run.js","error.log.js")
// BeaverTail loves dropping its python stager to user-writable temp dirs
| extend LikelyImplantDir = ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp",@"\AppData\Roaming",@"\Users\Public",@".npm\",@"\node_modules\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256, LikelyImplantDir
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Famous Chollima Contagious Interview — Sentinel (Sysmon/4688 via SecurityEvent or ASIM)
let Lookback = 14d;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where ParentProcessName endswith "node.exe"
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","import urllib","import requests","import socket","import base64","pip install","exec(","eval(","/pdown","/uploads","/keys","/client/")
   or ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("postinstall","preinstall","install.js","helper.js","loader.js","payload.js","main.js","run.js","error.log.js")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Famous Chollima Contagious Interview — node.exe spawns scripting interpreter with download/exec markers
id: 9d8f1a02-3a7c-4a39-9c6b-fa1c25c9b2e4
status: experimental
description: Detects BeaverTail-style execution where Node.js (typically invoked via npm install or node app.js from a malicious 'coding challenge' repo) spawns powershell/python/curl/wget/cmd with download or in-memory exec markers — the hand-off stage Famous Chollima uses to retrieve the InvisibleFerret Python backdoor.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015/
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/famous-chollima-targeting-crypto-industry/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/dprk-contagious-interview-lures/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  child_interpreter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\pip.exe'
  suspicious_child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'import urllib'
      - 'import requests'
      - 'import socket'
      - 'import base64'
      - 'pip install'
      - 'exec('
      - 'eval('
  suspicious_parent_cmd:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'postinstall'
      - 'preinstall'
      - 'install.js'
      - 'helper.js'
      - 'loader.js'
      - 'payload.js'
      - 'error.log.js'
  condition: parent and child_interpreter and (suspicious_child_cmd or suspicious_parent_cmd)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate post-install scripts in a developer build pipeline that happen to call out via curl/python (rare on workstations, common on build agents — scope to developer endpoints)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\Pwsh.exe OR *\python.exe OR *\Python.exe OR *\pythonw.exe OR *\PythonW.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\Curl.exe OR *\CURL.EXE OR *\wget.exe OR *\Wget.exe OR *\pip.exe OR *\Pip.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\Cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE) AND (@CommandLine:*http\:* OR @CommandLine:*https\:* OR @CommandLine:*DownloadString* OR @CommandLine:*Invoke-WebRequest* OR @CommandLine:*IEX* OR @CommandLine:*-EncodedCommand* OR @CommandLine:*"import urllib"* OR @CommandLine:*"import requests"* OR @CommandLine:*"import socket"* OR @CommandLine:*"pip install"* OR @CommandLine:*"exec("* OR @ParentCommandLine:*postinstall* OR @ParentCommandLine:*preinstall* OR @ParentCommandLine:*install.js* OR @ParentCommandLine:*helper.js* OR @ParentCommandLine:*loader.js* OR @ParentCommandLine:*error.log.js*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/node\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|python|pythonw|curl|wget|pip|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(https?://|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|\\bIEX\\b|Invoke-Expression|-Encoded(Command)?|import\\s+(urllib|requests|socket|base64|platform)|pip\\s+install|exec\\(|eval\\()", field=CommandLine)
   OR regex("(?i)(postinstall|preinstall|install\\.js|helper\\.js|loader\\.js|payload\\.js|error\\.log\\.js|main\\.js)", field=ParentCommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: Famous Chollima's Contagious Interview campaign is the only documented DPRK operation where Node.js is the consistent first-stage execution context: victims clone a 'coding test' from GitHub/Bitbucket and run npm install / node app.js, triggering BeaverTail (JavaScript info-stealer) which then shells out to retrieve InvisibleFerret (Python backdoor). The node.exe → (python.exe|powershell.exe|curl.

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima IT-worker fraud — unsanctioned remote-access tool install on new-hire dev endpoint + impossible-travel sign-in
ucs.description: Hunts the DPRK 'Wagemole' / IT-worker insider scheme where a North Korean operator, hired under a stolen/fabricated identity, installs AnyDesk / RustDesk / Chrome Remote Desktop on a corporate laptop (often shipped to a US laptop-farm) so the real operator in DPRK/RU/CN can drive it remotely. Correlates the install event with AAD sign-ins from non-baseline geographies within 7 days of account creation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstSeen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","AnyDeskMSI.exe","rustdesk.exe","RustDesk.exe","remotedesktophost.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","TeamViewer_Setup.exe","TeamViewer.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*AnyDesk*","*RustDesk*","*chromeremotedesktop*","*remotedesktophost*")) by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner user [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.app="Azure Active Directory" by Authentication.user Authentication.src Authentication.src_country _time | rename Authentication.* as * | lookup employee_baseline_geo user OUTPUT baseline_country | where isnull(baseline_country) OR src_country!=baseline_country | where src_country IN ("CN","RU","KP","HK","BY","LA")] | table firstSeen user dest process_name src src_country
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Famous Chollima IT-worker — Sentinel equivalent
let Lookback = 30d;
let RatNames = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","anydeskmsi.exe","rustdesk.exe","remotedesktophost.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","teamviewer_setup.exe","teamviewer.exe","meshagent.exe","meshcentral.exe"]);
let HighRiskGeos = dynamic(["CN","RU","KP","HK","BY","LA","VE"]);
let RatInstalls = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ProcLeaf in (RatNames)
       or CommandLine has_any ("AnyDesk","RustDesk","chromeremotedesktop","MeshCentral","--install","--service","/silent")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend Upn = strcat(tolower(SubjectUserName), "@", tolower(SubjectDomainName))
    | project InstallTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, Upn, ProcLeaf, CommandLine;
let RecentSignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | where Country in~ (HighRiskGeos)
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, AppDisplayName;
RatInstalls
| join kind=inner RecentSignIns on $left.Upn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where abs(datetime_diff('day', SignInTime, InstallTime)) <= 7
| project InstallTime, SignInTime, Computer, UserPrincipalName, ProcLeaf, CommandLine, Country, IPAddress, UserAgent, AppDisplayName
| order by InstallTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\AnyDeskMSI.exe OR *\anydeskmsi.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\remotedesktophost.exe OR *\RemoteDesktopHost.exe OR *\chromeremotedesktophost.exe OR *\ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer_Setup.exe OR *\MeshAgent.exe OR *\meshagent.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*AnyDesk* OR *anydesk* OR *RustDesk* OR *rustdesk* OR *chromeremotedesktop* OR *ChromeRemoteDesktop* OR *MeshCentral* OR *meshcentral*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(AnyDesk(MSI)?|RustDesk|remotedesktophost|chromeremotedesktophost|TeamViewer(_Setup)?|MeshAgent|meshcentral)\.exe$/i
   OR regex("(?i)(AnyDesk|RustDesk|chromeremotedesktop|MeshCentral|--install|--service)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventResult=Success | regex("(?i)^(CN|RU|KP|HK|BY|LA|VE)$", field=SourceCountryCode)}, field=UserPrincipal, key=UserName, include=[SourceCountryCode, SourceIp, UserAgent], mode=left)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SourceCountryCode, SourceIp], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen)])
| SourceCountryCode=/.+/
ucs.rationale: The DPRK IT-worker / 'Wagemole' scheme (Mandiant UNC5267, CrowdStrike Famous Chollima) is characterized by a unique TTP cocktail that distinguishes it from every other DPRK cluster (Lazarus, Kimsuky, Andariel): the operator is INSIDE the company on a legitimately issued endpoint and must establish persistent remote control of that endpoint without raising help-desk flags — the consistent solution
